¶
{{c|'''V.—OXIDES.'''}}

<poem>
1. {{sc|Oxides of Silicon}}.
Quartz . . . . . SiO<sub>2</sub> . . . . . . . . . R3
(Agate, Amethyst, Avanturine, Bloodstone,
Cairngorm, Carnelian, Cat's-eye, Chalcedony,
Chrysoprase, Heliotrope, Jasper, Mocha-stone,
Onyx, Rock-crystal, Sard, Sardonyx.)
Tridymite . . . SiO<sub>2</sub> . . . . . . . . O(?)
Opal . . . . . . SiO<sub>2</sub>+''n''H<sub>2</sub>O Amorphous
2. {{sc|Oxides of the Semi-Metals}}.
3. {{sc|Oxides of the Metals}}.
''A. Anhydrous Oxides.''
''a. Monoxides.''
Cuprite . . . . . Cu<sub>2</sub>O . . . . . . . . . C4
Zincite . . . . . ZnO . . . . . . . . . R2
Melaconite . . . CuO . . . . . . . . . M
''b. Sesquioxides.''
Corundum . . . Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> . . . . . . . . R
(Asteria, Emery, Ruby, Sapphire.)
Haematite . . . . Fe<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> . . . . . . . . . R
Ilmenite<sup>1</sup> . . . . FeTiO<sub>3</sub> . . . . . . . . R4
</poem>
